comments.text: We have several good Asian supermarket in the Denver area.  They carry lots of items that one would need to try to make some of these dishes I've had in Taiwan and China.  I've tried to make beef noodle soup several times.  The biggest issue I had was getting the correct cut of meat, so it has that soft texture with lines of fat in it.  Hit and miss...I'm still learning.  Oh, that paste *might* be a local version of doubanjiang.  Next time I make the soup, I'll get some of that and try it in the soup.  I'm headed to Slovakia to visit my cousin, and I'd like to make some of the meals for her, as although she's traveled quite a lot throughout Europe and even lived in the States for quite some time, she's never been anywhere in the Orient.  I'm hoping to take her next year to Taiwan.  I'm excited to see how amazed she'll be at what that country has to offer.
